claims.disproof_condition: Remove or downgrade if Lumentum divests/exits the ROADM/WSS product line or reclassifies it as immaterial in future filings; upgrade substitutability only with third-party or customer-side share evidence.
claims.statement: Lumentum's FY2026 10-K names wavelength-selective switches among the agile optical network technologies it addresses and lists ROADMs (whose switching engine is the WSS) in its offered optical transport product range. Supplier self-report from a statutory filing; the 10-K contains no market share or substitutability discussion, so no substitutability value is set on this edge — share data requires a third-party source.

source_doc.permission_basis: Public SEC EDGAR filing; URL and short excerpts only.
source_doc.title: Lumentum Holdings FY2026 10-K

sources.quote: Technologies like Reconfigurable Optical Add-Drop Multiplexers (“ROADMs”), wavelength-selective switches, and tunable transmission products facilitate remote capacity adjustments.
For optical transport applications, we offer a broad range of products, including ROADMs, optical amplifiers, and optical channel monitors to efficiently switch, route, and condition optical signals.
